The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 99c6295ef166983a), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 6. statement: Let J ⊆ G be nonempty and finite. Let Nj → ∞ be a sequence of positive integers, and let φj ∈ ∂e T(C). Suppose that φj(kNj;g,h) −→ Rg,h (g, h ∈ J). (3.6) Then R = (Rg,h)g,h∈J is a real positive semidefinite matrix with diagonal entries one. Choose unit vectors vg, g ∈ J, spanning a finite-dimensional real Euclidean space L, with ⟨vg, vh⟩ = Rg,h. If W is a standard Gaussian vector in L and ξg = ⟨vg, W⟩, then (zNj,g)g∈J , (kNj;g,h)g,h∈J  −→ (ξg)g∈J , (Rg,h)g,h∈J  in all ordered joint moments under φj. Equivalently, for every noncommutative ∗-polynomial P in these self-adjoint variables, φj P (zNj,g)g, (kNj;g,h)g,h  −→ E P (ξg)g, (Rg,h)g,h  . (3.7) For every sequence (Nj, φj) as above, a subsequence satisfying Equation (3.6) exists.
